question: Does the Chapter 2 JPN06 terminal stickiness placement and JPN06-JPN15 sister contrast survive own-data ancestry, ploidy, locus-sharing and network sensitivities?

primary_estimands.sister_relation: support for JPN06-JPN15 sister relationship across admitted own-data topology/network sensitivities
primary_estimands.terminal_localization: fraction of admitted own-data topology/history ensemble retaining a terminal JPN06 stickiness change
primary_estimands.minimum_change_burden: stickiness minimum-change lower bound after mapping same-individual or population-resolved states onto admitted own-data histories

predeclared_falsifiers: JPN06-JPN15 sister relationship is not retained across admitted own-data sensitivities
JPN06 terminal concentration is materially reduced or relocated across admitted own-data histories
strict-locus, ploidy-aware or network sensitivity reverses the focal placement

decision_rules.retain_chapter2_history: all admission gates pass and the sister relation plus terminal concentration remain qualitatively stable across the admitted sensitivity set
decision_rules.revise_chapter2_history: one or more predeclared falsifiers is met after admission gates pass
decision_rules.ancestry_only: cross-species admission gates fail; report population ancestry/within-cytotype structure and retain Comp1061 as primary cross-species scaffold

next_causal_test_if_history_retained: within-JPN15 stickiness neutralization versus sham with enemy access/damage and reproductive-fitness endpoints
claim_boundary: RAD-seq placement is historical evidence, not adaptation
a sister contrast does not establish defence function
minimum changes are not independent-origin counts
no manipulation proceeds without site-specific authorization and conservation review
